- To use one, get its input schema with find_tools, then run it with call_tool. Do this even when you know the name, and even when a skill names the tool.
- Skills and instructions often name a catalog tool directly, such as "call `some_tool` with the IDs". Read that as call_tool with tool "some_tool" and those arguments. Never emit a tool call whose name is a catalog tool.
- Look up every tool the task will need in one find_tools call at the start, not one at a time as each step comes up. You can make this call in the same response as other calls that do not need its result.
- When you do not know a tool's name, search by query or list a namespace.
</tool_catalog_rules>
